verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a system-level package manager for CLI tools and apps, not a language or project package manager. Monorepo workspaces with a shared lockfile and cross-linked local in-development packages fall outside its product category. Brewfiles only declare which environment tools a project needs; nothing in the evidence shows workspace, lockfile-sharing or local cross-linking capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage many packages in one monorepo with workspaces sharing a single lockfile and cross-linked local dependencies
